# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We are committed to providing a welcoming, inclusive, and harassment-free experience for everyone participating in this project.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Assume good intent and ask clarifying questions.
- Provide actionable feedback focused on code and outcomes.
- Accept and give feedback professionally.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Trolling, insulting, or derogatory comments.
- Publishing private information without explicit consent.
- Any conduct that would be inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, report it privately via:

- GitHub Security Advisories: https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/mysql-business-to-schema/security/advisories/new
- Repository owner contact through GitHub profile

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, issues, and other contributions that violate this Code of Conduct.
